# BOARD OF HEALTH SPECIAL MEETING

## MINUTES

## AUGUST 25, 2026

A meeting of the Bristol-Burlington Health District's Board of Health was held in the Bristol-Burlington Health District Office, 240 Stafford Avenue, Bristol, Connecticut

**Members Present:** Brian Suchinski, Chairman; Doug Thompson, Burlington Town Selectman, Burlington Representative; Donna Friday; Thomas O'Brien; Jeffrey Beauchamp

**Staff present:** Marco Palmeri, MPH, RS, Director of Health; Louise McGlone, Office Manager, Board of Health Secretary

The meeting was called to order by Chairman Suchinski at 2:45 p.m.

### 1. Attendance

- One absence – Vice Chairwoman Kathy Langlais

### 2. Discussion and Action of MOU with the New Britain Health Department

- **Motion** by Member Doug Thompson, seconded by Member Donna Friday to approve the MOU with New Britain Health Department. **All in Favor. Motion carried.**

### 3. Discussion of Ford Harrison Law Firm

- **Motion** by Member Thomas O'Brien, seconded by Member Jeffrey Beauchamp to approve payment of the Ford Harrison Law Firm invoice exceeding $25,000, with no cap on future invoices. **All in Favor. Motion carried.**

### 4. Adjournment

- **Motion** by Member Donna Friday, seconded by Chairman Suchinski to adjourn at 2:52 p.m. **All in Favor. Motion carried.**

Respectfully submitted,

[signature]

Marco Palmeri, MPH, RS

Director of Health
